Since you ordered yesterday, it's past the 2-hour window for free online cancellation, so the order is in the packing queue. Support can try to intercept it before it ships, but that isn't guaranteed. If it has already shipped, it can't be cancelled. Would you like me to escalate LF-204518 to a Support Lead to attempt an intercept? If it works, your card is only authorised until the order ships, and a pending authorisation drops off in 3-7 business days depending on your bank.

Promo codes can't be added after an order is placed, so the forgotten code can't be applied to LF-204518.
